source.snippet: Enterprise sysadmin: 'During Windows Setup I load the Cisco VIC vHBA driver. Because two paths are active, setup detects the target LUN twice as separate disks... Windows fails to boot... Constraint: No administrative access to MDS SAN switches or storage array.' Cisco UCS + XtremIO environment.

problem_statement: Enterprise sysadmins configuring Windows Boot-from-SAN on Cisco UCS with multi-path FC storage face boot failures caused by duplicate LUN detection, and lack tooling or documentation to resolve this without SAN switch admin access.
target_segment: Enterprise infrastructure engineers and sysadmins managing Cisco UCS blade environments with FC SAN storage
notes: Enterprise environment — Cisco UCS + Dell EMC XtremIO implies large IT budget. Pain is a deployment blocker with real downtime cost. Niche but high-value: a runbook service or validated configuration guide could command $500–$5k per engagement.
